name: Financial gap law draft (cabinet, December 2025): tax on pre-crisis transfers abroad
detail: A levy on money sent abroad before the crisis unless it returns within a set time: a recovery measure on transfers, not a tax on the stock of wealth.

name: Sayrafa windfall tax (2026 budget law, article 52)
detail: Extra 17% tax on gains from buying dollars through the Sayrafa platform above USD 100,000 in 2021-2023: a tax on trading gains.

name: Ministry of Finance: tax on banks' crisis-year profits and "lollar" windfall (2026)
detail: Dispute between the Ministry of Finance and the Association of Banks over corporate tax on 2020-2025 returns and a windfall tax on repaid loans; corporate and windfall taxes.

name: The Policy Initiative: Lebanon's 2023 draft budget, taxing the many, sparing the rich
detail: Critique of the budget's tax mix and exemptions for banks; the page opened did not call for a tax on net wealth.

name: World Bank Lebanon Economic Monitor, Fall 2022 (bail-in of bank shareholders and large depositors)
detail: Argues for an equitable banking resolution that makes shareholders and the largest depositors bear losses: loss allocation in bank resolution, not a wealth tax.

name: Legal Agenda Parliamentary Observatory (Imad Saigh, 11 April 2022)
detail: Analysis of the Joumblatt bill that calls it a tax "in need of an economic feasibility study" and lists its flaws; it describes rather than endorses the tax, so the observatory is not recorded as a supporter.

name: Lebanese Communist Party election programme: tax on bank interest 7-15% and 30% corporate tax
detail: Other items in the same programme; only the 2% net wealth tax is recorded (E00003).
